DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy with superimposed Occupational Asthma/COPD due to dust exposure.

Given your landscaping work, seasonal allergies, and the X-ray showing hyperinflation, the dust exposure is likely triggering airway inflammation that exacerbates your shortness of breath and causes the nighttime cough. Have you noticed any improvement in your symptoms when you take allergy medication or avoid dusty environments?
